title: SAP Coupa  Source to Pay
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!


Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.


We are looking for SAP Coupa - Source to Pay who wants to learn and transform his career.


In this role you will: (responsibilities)


"Responsibilities for this role include:

Developer with knowledge Solutions Design for Coupa, Configuration, Documentation, Testing, and Delivery with intelligent automation (Scope includes work among SAP and non-SAP Systems and Applications)

Excellent technical & functional configuration knowledge and demonstrated proficiency for SAP Source to Pay, inclusive of Smart Contract Management, Spend Analytics, Guided Buying, and Collaborative Supply Chain & Procurement Materials Management, Materials Management (Direct and Indirect)

Participate in gathering and documenting overall business requirements. Support all formal documentation of implementation and provide relevant functional inputs to technical team.

Configure and implement Coupa solutions for source to pay processes. Should be able to perform global Coupa configuration, Approval Workflow, Custom field set up for transactions, Chart of account, PO forms, Catalog, Supplier, Item, User setup, Security Roles and Permission as per business requirement.

Experience in Coupa Configuration and data loads in Sourcing, Contracting, Purchasing, invoicing Master data(Supplier, Materials and Accounting data) and Catalog Management.

Experience with Coupa integration and mapping to legacy SAP systems for transactional and master data interface in source to pay.

Create functional specification documents that require development of WRICEF (Workflow Reports Interfaces Conversion Enhancement and Form) objects

Prepare test cases, validate deliverables, and support client testing and user acceptance testing (UAT).

Responsible for solving complex business problems by creating IT solutions in consultation with business partners, architects and other stakeholders"


What can you expect from us?


• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

• Opportunities to work outside Brazil

• A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.


What do we offer?


TCS Benefits – Brazil:

Health insurance

Dental Plan

Life insurance

Transportation vouchers

Meal/Food Voucher

Childcare assistance

Gympass

TCS Cares – free 0800 that provides psychological assistance (24 hrs/day), legal, social and financial assistance to associates

Partnership with SESC

Reimbursement of Certifications

Free TCS Learning Portal – Online courses and live training

International experience opportunity

Discount Partnership with Universities and Language Schools

Bring Your Buddy – By referring people you become eligible to receive a bonus for each hire

TCS Gems – Recognition for performance

Xcelerate – Free Mentoring Career Platform


At TATA Consultancy Services we promote an inclusive culture, we always work for equity. This applies to Gender, People with Disabilities, LGBTQIA+, Religion, Race, Ethnicity. All our opportunities are based on these principles. We think of different actions of inclusion and social responsibility, in order to build a TCS that respects individuality. Come to be a TCSer!

Nosso propósito é apoiar nossos clientes na implementação de produtos financeiros e em melhorias de jornadas. Trabalhamos com NuBank, Banco Next e Natura Pay...


Requisitos

  • Experiência sólida com .NET Core / ASP.NET.
  • Domínio de C#, APIs RESTful e padrões como DTOs.
  • Conhecimento em versionamento de APIs (ApiVersioning, rotas versionadas).
  • Conhecimento em bancos de dados relacionais e não-relacionais.
  • Domínio em Git e controle de versão.
  • Experiência com integração de APIs, sistemas externos e micro serviços.
  • Boa comunicação e adaptabilidade a diferentes projetos e linguagens.
  • Experiência com autenticação/autorização (JWT, OAuth2)
  • Vivência com testes automatizados (unitários e de integração).
  • Experiência com integração de sistemas e manipulação de dados externos.
  • Espanhol avançado


Diferenciais:

  • Experiência com arquitetura limpa (Clean Architecture) e arquitetura hexagonal
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de monitoramento, logging e observabilidade (Serilog, Application Insights, Prometheus, Grafana, Kibana).
  • Familiaridade com mensageria (AWS SQS, AWS SNS, Kafka, RabbitMQ) e padrões como Circuit Breaker e Retry.
  • Experiência com gestão de secrets e configuração segura em ambientes diversos.

title: Desenvolvedor Frontend - Remoto
description:
A Getronics é líder global em soluções de tecnologia, com uma equipe de mais de 4.000 colegas em 22 países, fornecendo serviços abrangentes de ponta a ponta em todo o mundo. Temos o compromisso de oferecer um atendimento excepcional ao cliente, para permitir que eles se concentrem em seus principais pontos fortes, enquanto confiam suas necessidades de TI à Getronics. Temos uma oportunidade incrível para você se juntar à nossa equipe, na seguinte vaga: Desenvolvedor Front-end - Remoto.


O que oferecemos a você

- Assistência médica sem desconto para titulares;

- Assistência odontológica sem desconto para titulares;

- Cartão flex tanto para alimentação quanto refeição;

- Auxílio home office para vaga remota;

- Vale transporte para posições presenciais ou híbridas;

- Auxílio creche;

- Seguro de vida;

- Desconto em terapia: plataforma de apoio psicossocial;

- Parceria com instituições de ensino;

- Parceria com escolas de idiomas;

- Programa de subsídio para aulas de inglês;

- Programa de indicações: prêmio para indicações bem-sucedidas; - Licença maternidade estendida de 180 dias e a licença paternidade de 20 dias;

- Treinamento completo fornecido como parte de um processo de indução robusto, incluindo oportunidades de desenvolvimento contínuo com nossa plataforma de aprendizado online NorthStar, LinkedIn Learning e Udemy, que possui mais de 80.000 cursos disponíveis;

- GetVibes - nosso programa de escuta ativa que nos permite conectar e ouvir feedback de todos os colegas, e como empresa, trabalhamos juntos para elaborar planos de ação para melhorar e desenvolver continuamente a Getronics!


O que esperar dessa posição:

Atuação no desenvolvimento e melhorias de sistemas bancários.


O que esperamos de você:

  • Linguagens: JavaScript e TypeScript
  • Frameworks: Angular 16+, Bootstrap e Tailwind
  • Testes: Jest, Karma e Jasmine
  • CI/CD: Docker e Docker Compose
  • Versionamento: Git
  • Ferramentas Angular: RxJS, NgRx e Angular CLI
  • Front-end responsivo: HTML5, CSS3 e SASS/SCSS
  • Integração com APIs: REST e GraphQL
  • Boas práticas: SOLID, Clean Code, componentização e reutilização de código
  • Metodologias Ágeis: Scrum e Kanban


O que fazer em seguida:

Caso você seja a pessoa que estamos procurando, aguarde nosso contato para te conhecermos melhor e siga as instruções durante o processo seletivo. Se você gostaria de fazer alguma pergunta sobre nossas vagas, sobre a Getronics como empresa ou qualquer outra coisa, por favor, não hesite em entrar em contato. A equipe de RH estará disponível no e-mail

title: Power BI Developer
description:
One of our clients which is having operations globally is looking a Power BI Developer for a fully remote in Latin America. Please find the below job description and request you to share me your resume to


Job Title: Power BI Developer (Fully Remote)

Job Type: Long term contract

Location: Remote in Brazil/ or any other country in Latin America


Experience: 5+ years in Power BI development

Job Description:

We are seeking a skilled Power BI Developer to join our team in a fully remote capacity. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience in creating impactful dashboards , writing advanced DAX formulas, and integrating data using SQL .


Key Responsibilities:

  • Design, develop, and maintain interactive Power BI dashboards and reports.
  • Write efficient and complex DAX measures and calculated columns to support business logic.
  • Connect to and transform data from various sources using SQL .
  • Collaborate with business stakeholders to gather requirements and deliver actionable insights.
  • Ensure data accuracy, performance optimization, and visual best practices.


Requirements:

  • Proven experience with Power BI , DAX , and SQL .
  • Strong understanding of data modeling, ETL processes, and report design.
  • Ability to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Excellent analytical and communication skills.


Nice to Have:

  • Experience with Power Query (M language).
  • Familiarity with cloud data sources (e.g., Azure, Snowflake, AWS).

title: Desenvolvedor(a) PEGA – Automação e Integração de Sistemas
description:
➡️Formação

Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas;


➡️Nível de experiência

Sênior


➡️Setor

TI/Telecom


➡️Local de atuação

100% Remoto


Buscamos um(a) profissional com sólida experiência em desenvolvimento na plataforma PEGA, com forte atuação em projetos integrados, para compor nosso time de tecnologia em iniciativas de alta complexidade e transformação digital.

➡️Requisitos e Qualificações

3 a 5 anos de experiência com desenvolvimento de soluções na plataforma Pega.


➡️Responsabilidades e Atribuições:

Atuar em projetos de automação de processos utilizando a plataforma PEGA.

Desenvolver e manter aplicações com foco em BPM (Business Process Management) e Case Management.

Integrar sistemas legados e modernos via REST/SOAP APIs, conectores e serviços PEGA. Participar da definição de arquitetura de soluções e boas práticas de desenvolvimento.

Realizar testes unitários, funcionais e suporte à homologação.

Colaborar com times multidisciplinares em ambientes ágeis.


➡️Conhecimentos Técnicos:

Experiência com desenvolvimento na plataforma PEGA PRPC (versões 7.x, 8.x ou superior). Conhecimento em PEGA Rules, Flows, Activities, Data Pages, Reports, UI Rules.

Experiência com integrações de sistemas, SOAP/REST, JMS, MQ.

Desejável conhecimento em DevOps, Docker, Kubernetes e CI/CD com PEGA.


➡️Certificações:

Certified Pega System Architect (CPSA)

Certified Pega Senior System Architect (CPSSA)

Colaborar com times multidisciplinares em ambientes ágeis.

Experiência com desenvolvimento na plataforma PEGA PRPC (versões 7.x, 8.x ou superior). Conhecimento em PEGA Rules, Flows, Activities, Data Pages, Reports, UI Rules.

Desejável conhecimento em DevOps, Docker, Kubernetes e CI/CD com PEGA.

Certified Pega System Architect (CPSA)

Certified Pega Senior System Architect (CPSSA)

title: Senior Java Software Engineer
description:
Join OSF Digital as a Backend Developer, where you will design and build server-side components using Java, ensuring clean and efficient code. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to optimize backend performance and security while contributing to innovative digital experiences for our users.



Job Description


  • Backend Development:

Design and build server-side components, including APIs and databases, using Java and relevant frameworks, ensuring clean and maintainable code.

  • API Work:

Implement and integrate RESTful APIs, manage data validation, and handle errors, possibly integrating with external services.

  • Database Management:

Design and optimize databases for performance, maintain data integrity, and work with various database systems.

  • Testing & QA:

Conduct unit and integration tests to maintain code quality, identify bugs, and optimize performance.

  • Team Collaboration:

Engage with cross-functional teams to meet project goals, requiring strong communication and teamwork skills.


Technical Competencies:


  • Java Programming:

Strong knowledge and experience in the Java programming language. Understanding of core concepts, syntax, and best practices.

  • Server-Side Development:

Experience in building server-side applications and APIs using Java frameworks such as Spring Boot.

  • Relational Databases:

Proficiency in working with relational databases like MySQL, PostgreSQL, or Oracle. Knowledge of SQL, data modeling, and database optimization.

  • Web Development:

Understanding of web development concepts and technologies such as HTTP, RESTful APIs, JSON, and XML.

  • Java Frameworks and Libraries:

Familiarity with popular Java frameworks and libraries such as Spring Framework, Hibernate, or Apache Kafka.

  • Unit Testing:

Experience with unit testing frameworks like JUnit. Knowledge of software testing principles and practices.

  • Version Control:

Proficiency in using version control systems like Git for code management and collaboration.


Analytical and Problem-Solving Competencies:


  • Analytical Skills:

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills to identify and resolve issues in the backend code and infrastructure.

  • Performance Optimization:

Knowledge of performance optimization techniques, such as caching, indexing, and query optimization, to ensure efficient and scalable backend systems.


Cloud Experience:

  • Cloud Services:

Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS. Ability to deploy and manage applications in a cloud environment, leveraging cloud services for scalability and performance.



OSF Digital is proud to be an equal opportunity employer, where you can bring your whole self to work. Join an inclusive and passionate community of professionals who help bring about digital transformation for businesses around the world. At OSF Digital, we welcome all individuals and do not discriminate on the basis of gender identity and expression, race, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, color, religion, national origin, age, marital status, or any other protected category in any of the jurisdictions in which we conduct business. Explore our opportunities and join us on an amazing journey!

title: Desenvolvedor(a) Full Stack Sênior (.NET e Angular)
description:
Estamos em busca de um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) Full-Stack Sênior para integrar nosso time e contribuir com soluções robustas e escaláveis! Se você gosta de desafios, trabalha bem em ambientes colaborativos e tem experiência em .NET, Angular e Microsoft Azure, essa vaga é para você!


Descrição das atividades:

  • Desenvolver e manter aplicações web completas, incluindo front-end (Angular) e back-end (.NET);
  • Integrar APIs e serviços utilizando práticas modernas de segurança e escalabilidade;

  • Criar e gerenciar Azure Functions para orquestração de serviços e automação;
  • Participar do ciclo de vida completo do desenvolvimento, incluindo design, testes e deploy;
  • Trabalhar com Kubernetes para orquestração e gerenciamento de contêineres;
  • Colaborar com equipes de design, DevOps e gerentes de projetos para garantir entregas de alta qualidade;
  • Identificar e corrigir bugs, além de otimizar o desempenho de aplicações;
  • Manter e evoluir sistemas legados desenvolvidos em .NET Framework, Windows Forms e Windows Services.

  • Experiência prática com desenvolvimento em .NET (C#) e Angular;
  • Conhecimento sólido em tecnologias legadas: .NET Framework, Windows Forms e Windows Services ;
  • Familiaridade com arquitetura de microsserviços e consumo de APIs RESTful;
  • Conhecimento em Microsoft Azure, incluindo Azure Functions, App Services e bancos de dados na nuvem;
  • Boas práticas de versionamento utilizando Git;
  • Experiência com práticas de CI/CD em pipelines de deploy na nuvem;
  • Experiência com Kubernetes para gerenciamento de contêineres.


100% Remoto!

Job Title: Project Control Analyst -

Location: Brazil

Type: Fulltime (Remote)

Language Required - English (Professional)


Responsibilities:

Job Description Summary


Job Description

  • This role is embedded in the team global service organization as a business partner, reporting to the PCA Manager and indirectly to the Regional Finance Leader.
  • Should have good experience in SAP, Earned value management and Project Controls.
  • The project control analyst will be responsible to support regional project control initiatives & drive standardization of PCA processes using applied on-the-job standard work.
  • The mission specifically includes:
  • Develop and harmonies PCA Processes / Workflows.
  • Support Continuous Improvement Initiatives on PCA / Finance topics.
  • Actively track and manage to the PCA KPI’s.
  • Work Closely with the Project Management Office to:
  • Manage, track and provide analysis on support contracts and projects (sales, forecast estimates to complete, actuals, cost reconciliations, risks and opportunities, cash forecasts).
  • Performs financial analysis (budget deviations and identify root causes) for Project Manager, Project Management Office and HQ reporting.
  • Enters and maintains all project financial data in ERP (orders, invoicing, budgets, purchase requisitions).
  • Support invoicing and cash collection of project and support contracts.
  • Deliver monthly close of assigned business units by country and communicate any exceptions.


Further Essential Responsibilities

  • Drive PCA Lessons Learned and improve efficiency, actively engage in the Continuous Improvement and further Lean Initiatives
  • Ensure compliance to the Global Standard process for Project Controls
  • Support PM to align P6 project budgets to as sold in the ERP system
  • Liaison with Central Quality function to ensure alignment of regional best practices to global Quality standards
  • Liaison with other appropriate Teams within the Region e.g. Comm Ops, Finance, Sales required in the formation of the End-to-End Project Control

Processes.

  • Participate in Project reviews as part of the Leader Standard Work, to ensure the application of the defined Project Control approach.


Qualifications/Requirements

  • Fluent in English.
  • SAP Super User (preferred)
  • Excellent excel, Smartsheet or equivalent.
  • Strong Project Financial Management background (5 years’ experience).
  • Strong experience in used PCA tools and related processes.
  • Previous work experience in multi-cultural global environment.
  • Personally, capable to drive changes through functional reporting lines and manage by influence.

· Work with the best – Join 140,000+ bold thinkers and problem-solvers who push boundaries every day

· Thrive in a values-driven culture – Our courage, curiosity, and incisiveness - built on a foundation of integrity and inclusion - allow your ideas to fuel progress

Come join the tech shapers and growth makers at Genpact and take your career in the only direction that matters: Up.


Let’s build tomorrow together.

title: 10869 - Cientista de Dados
description:
Principais responsabilidades :

  • Profissional atuará como Cientista de Dados, atuando com realização do ajuste fino (fine-tuning) de modelos pré-treinados com bases de dados internas ou públicas, aplicando técnicas como LoRA, PEFT e distilação, quando necessário;
  • Aplicar engenharia de prompts para otimizar interações com LLMs via APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Cohere, Hugging Face, etc);
  • Implementar pipelines inteligentes com ETL automatizado, utilizando boas práticas de versionamento de dados e reprodutibilidade;
  • Integrar modelos em fluxos de negócio utilizando frameworks como LangChain e APIs REST/GraphQL;
  • Analisar resultados, definir métricas de sucesso e realizar validações contínuas dos modelos (F1, BLEU, perplexidade);

title: Senior Business Controller / CFO (Executive Leadership Program Track - Latin) – Global Industrial Leader
description:
Senior Business Controller (Executive Leadership Program Track) – Global Industrial Leader


Location: Initial landing role in Hong Kong or other key cities (depending on where you are), with potential rotations globally

Company: A globally integrated industrial leader with end-to-end value chain excellence


Your Mission:

Shape financial excellence for a multinational industrial powerhouse and accelerate your trajectory as a future enterprise leader. As the cornerstone of our executive development pipeline, you will partner with C-suite stakeholders to drive strategic alignment, optimize risk-resilient governance, and fuel sustainable value creation across HQ and regional operations. This role is your launchpad to broader executive responsibilities within 18–24 months.


Core Responsibilities:

Strategic Financial Leadership

  • Reinvent budgeting, forecasting, and cash flow optimization for industrial complexes and business units.
  • Fortify integrated risk frameworks (finance/tax/legal/compliance) while preserving operational agility.
  • Advise on M&A, investments, and market expansion through a value-creation lens.


Operational Transformation

  • Oversee accounting operations, ensuring flawless adherence to global policies and controls.
  • Optimize statutory/tax compliance and finance/legal structures across jurisdictions.
  • Partner with plant leadership on CAPEX strategy, scalability, and ROI-driven execution.


Stakeholder & Risk Stewardship

  • Cultivate strategic relationships with regulators, auditors, and advisors across selected locations.
  • Manage external vendors to balance cost efficiency with premium quality.
  • Champion finance perspectives in C-suite forums as a trusted enterprise advisor.


Talent & Culture Catalyst

  • Mentor high-potential finance teams in business partnering and strategic analysis.
  • Instill a culture of precision, continuous improvement, and cross-functional collaboration.


Pathway to Executive Leadership

  • Excel in this high-visibility controller role for 18–24 months before rotating into broader enterprise leadership
  • Gain exposure to board-level decision-making, M&A integration, and pan-Asian P&L management.


Required Expertise:

Non-Negotiables

  • 10+ years’ progressive finance leadership, including 5+ years as Head of Controlling/Regional Controller in industrial/manufacturing sectors.
  • Professional Credentials: ACCA, HKICPA, CPA, or equivalent.
  • Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s in Finance, Accounting, or related field from a top-tier institution.
  • Language: Fluent English and Mandarin a must, Portuguese a strong plus


Proven Impact

  • Mastery of complex accounting, tax structuring, and internal control frameworks.
  • Track record in M&A due diligence, cash flow transformation, and enterprise risk mitigation.
  • Success in matrixed, privately held organizations with legacy operations.


Leadership DNA

  • Architect, not just operator: Strengthens foundations while designing future-ready solutions.
  • Ambassador: Influences stakeholders with integrity, diplomacy, and executive presence.
  • Accelerator: Develops talent and drives continuous improvement as a cultural cornerstone.

title: Software Engineer
description:
About us

Are you looking for an exciting opportunity to join a fast-growing fintech company that is revolutionizing the payment industry? Do you want to work with cutting-edge technologies and a talented team of professionals? If yes, then Wallester AS might be the perfect place for you!


Wallester AS is an Estonian licensed payment service provider that develops financial digital technology and issues VISA cards. Since 2018, we have been an official Visa partner and Visa FinTech Fast Track Member issuing physical and virtual cards of any type: debit cards, credit cards, prepaid cards, and cards for business. Our distinctive advantage is a unique REST API created by our in-house development team. Easily integrated with any platform, it allows you to launch your card program in no time!


We are looking for passionate and driven individuals who share our vision of creating truly high-quality and profitable products for our clients.


About the role


As a Software Engineer at Wallester, you will play a key role in developing and maintaining our unique platform that enables our clients to launch their card programs in no time. You will be involved in all stages of the software development life cycle, from planning and analysis to deployment and maintenance. You will also have the opportunity to work with cutting-edge technologies and a talented team of professionals.


If you are passionate about FinTech and payment solutions, have excellent technical skills, and enjoy working in a fast-paced environment, then this role is for you!


Location


We are seeking Software Engineering specialists to join Wallester’s headquarters in Tallinn (Golden Gate, Rotermanni Quarter) and our Latvian office in Riga (Jupiter Tower).


Technology stack


  • Golang
  • gRPC
  • Protocol Buffers
  • PostgreSQL
  • Redis
  • JSON REST API
  • Docker
  • Kubernetes
  • Linkerd
  • AWS infrastructure
  • Microservice Architecture


What will you do?


  • Participate in the whole software development life cycle
  • Write high-quality, efficient, and maintainable code that follows company standards
  • Collaborate with Engineers across the company to build new features
  • Actively contribute to adopting best practices in Software Engineering, improvement of processes, and team culture


What you'll need


  • 3+ years of experience in software development using any OOP language (C# / Java / PHP / JavaScript / etc.)
  • Experience with microservice architecture, REST API, RPC, PostgreSQL, and Docker
  • You have good English and communication skills
  • Experience working with agile software development teams
  • Problem-solving skills and ability to work in a fast-paced environment
  • Ability to work independently and proactively


Nice to have


  • Experience in working with cloud platforms (AWS/GCP/Azure)
  • Skilled in applying CI/CD infrastructure for software development and delivery
  • Experience in test methodologies and frameworks
  • Experience in financial software development
  • Knowledge of security best practices and standards (OWASP, PCI DSS)
  • Also, a spark in the eyes is always a plus!


We offer


  • Competitive salary
  • Development and career opportunities
  • Medical Insurance upon the completion of the probationary period
  • Supportive and caring Leadership
  • A modern office in the city center (Tallinn: Golden Gate and Riga: Jupiter Tower).
  • A chance to work as part of a highly motivated and talented team
  • Referral program
  • Stebby
  • Team buildings and Company Events
  • Free parking

title: Especialista Red Hat
description:
VAGA ABERTA: Especialista Red Hat Sênior – Remoto


Em busca de uma carreira em uma empresa que valoriza a flexibilidade, desenvolvimento pessoal e sucesso da equipe? Com 28 anos de experiência e reconhecidos pelo GPTW pelo quinto ano consecutivo, estamos em busca de talentos para se juntarem a nós como Especialista Red Hat . Com matriz no Brasil e filiais em território internacional, oferecemos oportunidades para crescimento e desenvolvimento. Candidate-se agora e faça parte de uma equipe que transforma negócios e realiza sonhos!


Requisitos essenciais:


  • Graduação em Tecnologia da Informação ou qualquer curso superior com pós-graduação na área de TI (mínimo de 360 horas);
  • Experiência na área de TI;
  • Experiência comprovada em Ansible, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, Python, Jinja2, Groovy, PowerShell, Bash e outras ferramentas de automação;
  • Experiência em Desenvolvimento Seguro;
  • Certificações: Red Hat Certified Specialist in Ansible Automation ou Red Hat Certified Engineer e OutSystems Security Specialization Exam ou CSSLP – Certified Secure Software Lifecycle Professional .


Requisitos adicionais:


  • Conhecimento em práticas ágeis: design incremental, design thinking, planning poker, refatoração, testes automatizados, BDD, TDD, DevOps, programação em par, inspeção e revisão de código, definição de pronto e preparado, integração e entrega contínuas, propriedade coletiva do código, histórias de usuário, critérios de aceitação, linguagem Gherkin, PDCA, produtização, IaC e CaC;
  • Familiaridade com frameworks: Manifesto Ágil, SCRUM, KANBAN, Lean, XP, DevOps, SAFe®, SRE, ITIL, COBIT, AIOps, FinOps, CMMI, MPS.BR e SOx;
  • Experiência com as nuvens Azure e AWS;
  • Vivência com ferramentas de inteligência artificial, como ChatGPT, GitHub Copilot, plataformas de geração de imagens ou automação de processos, aplicadas a: Automatização de tarefas, criação de relatórios e análise de dados, apoio à tomada de decisão e inovação contínua, melhoria da eficiência operacional e qualidade das entregas.


Responsabilidades:


  • Planejar, implementar, monitorar e aprimorar automações que impactam usuários finais, times de desenvolvimento e o time de sistemas, reduzindo intervenções manuais por meio da integração com ferramentas de ITSM, como o ServiceNow;
  • Desenvolver, testar, validar, divulgar e oferecer suporte operacional a novas automações ou melhorias, colaborando com diversas equipes para identificar e resolver problemas, além de planejar e executar otimizações;
  • Trabalhar com ferramentas como Ansible, SailPoint IIQ, Azure AD, Jenkins, SonarQube, GitLab, GitHub, GitHub Actions, Acunetix, Jira, Checkmarx e Automation Anywhere, adaptando-se a novas tecnologias adotadas pelo cliente em até dois meses;
  • Atuar estrategicamente na segurança da informação, garantindo a adoção de melhores práticas, como análise de segurança, implementação de security gates no pipeline DevSecOps e correção de vulnerabilidades;
  • Operar e auxiliar equipes no uso de ferramentas como DAST (Acunetix) e AI Mentor, acompanhando e garantindo a mitigação de riscos, elaborando planos de ação e assegurando o cumprimento de prazos;
  • Servir como ponto focal para questões de segurança, representando a área de Segurança da Informação em programas de conscientização e promovendo o desenvolvimento seguro;
  • Capacitar equipes por meio de treinamentos, workshops e criação de materiais educativos sobre práticas de DevSecOps;
  • Colaborar na formação e suporte de Champions OutSystems, promovendo a disseminação de conhecimentos e estabelecendo mecanismos de melhoria contínua para desenvolvimento seguro e práticas de DevSecOps na organização.


Nossos cuidados com você:

*Benefícios a variar de acordo com a modalidade de contrato


Vale Alimentação ou Vale Refeição Ifood Empresas;

Benefício indireto (valor fixo para custeio parcial do plano de saúde ou somado ao vale alimentação);

‍ Desconto em cursos, universidades e instituições de idiomas;

Academia Sys Manager - plataforma com cursos online, gratuitos, atualizados e com certificado;

Auxílio Creche;

Assistência Médica;
